verdict.rationale: cubic documents noise-reduction mechanisms: thumbs up/down reactions and comment replies calibrate "what's useful vs noise," it learns team rules from past senior reviews, findings auto-resolve once fixed, and cubic.yaml supports ignore patterns. One community user says the current balance "works very well." There is no evidence of severity labels or comment deduplication, and no measured false-positive data. Missing for 10: severity labels on findings, deduplication of comments, independent evidence of a low false-positive rate.
